overview: This paper proposes a task-related visual token compression method for MLLMs that leverages explainability methods to assess visual token importance and trains a lightweight convolutional network to predict these scores from first-layer attention maps, enabling efficient token pruning at the LLM input stage.

modules.name: Explainability Relevance Map Computation
modules.description: Computes global relevance scores for visual tokens by iteratively propagating gradient-weighted multi-head attention maps backward through the LLM layers, and aggregating the contribution scores across all decoding steps to generate the final visual relevance map.

modules.name: Data Sampling and Filtering
modules.description: Samples diverse image and video instruction data from source datasets while balancing task types and durations, and filters out low-quality pairs by verifying the base MLLM's response accuracy to ensure only correct samples are used for training.

modules.name: Training Feature Extraction
modules.description: Performs forward and backward passes through the frozen MLLM to extract the first-layer instruction-to-vision attention maps and the corresponding ground-truth visual relevance maps for the sampled data pairs, saving them as inputs for the compressor.

modules.name: Lightweight Compressor Architecture
modules.description: Implements a one-dimensional fully convolutional neural network with depthwise separable convolutions that maps the averaged first-layer attention vector to a visual relevance probability distribution without changing the token sequence length.

modules.name: Compressor Training
modules.description: Trains the lightweight convolutional network using KL divergence loss, where the target label is derived by masking the bottom fraction of the ground-truth relevance map and normalizing the remainder into a probability distribution.

modules.name: Input-Stage Token Pruning
modules.description: Executes the pruning logic during inference by predicting visual token relevance using the trained compressor, ranking the tokens based on the predicted scores, and dropping tokens below a specified retention threshold before the main LLM computation.

modules.name: MLLM Inference Integration
modules.description: Patches the forward propagation of various MLLM architectures to intercept visual and instruction tokens, apply the input-stage pruning module, and seamlessly continue the standard prefill and decode phases with the compressed token set.

modules.name: Evaluation Benchmarking
modules.description: Runs inference on comprehensive image and video understanding benchmarks, parsing outputs for multiple-choice and open-ended questions, and calculating task-specific accuracy metrics as well as performance preservation ratios relative to the baseline.

modules.name: Efficiency Analysis
modules.description: Profiles the computational cost by calculating theoretical FLOPs for the LLM and compressor, measuring end-to-end inference latency, tracking prefilling speedup, and evaluating peak KV-cache memory usage during generation.

modules.name: Ablation Experiment
modules.description: Configures controlled experiments to evaluate the impact of different relevance aggregation methods, compressor network depths, and source attention layers on compression performance and efficiency.

modules.name: Visualization and Interpretation
modules.description: Overlays computed and predicted relevance heatmaps on input images or video frames, and visualizes the retained token masks to qualitatively interpret the compressor's focus regions and pruning behavior.
